title: Tin chuyen nhuong: Man Utd dan dau cuoc dua gianh Mateus Fernandes

scenes.subjectHint: Hook — Mateus Fernandes giua cuoc giang co Man Utd / Arsenal / PSG / Real
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 football poster artwork featuring Mateus Fernandes, the Portuguese midfielder for West Ham United, in an intense focused hero pose with arms slightly spread, the centre of a transfer tug-of-war. He wears the claret-and-sky-blue West Ham United home kit with the West Ham crossed-hammers crest clearly visible on the chest. Background: a dramatic dark graphic backdrop split into four glowing color quadrants, each carrying a huge faint club crest watermark — Manchester United red, Arsenal red-and-white, Paris Saint-Germain navy, and Real Madrid white — radiating light rays converging on the player. Vibrant saturated high-contrast palette, glossy graphic-design finish, transfer-saga energy. Stylized like a summer transfer-window promotional poster. The West Ham crest visible on the jersey, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
